conclusion: scripts/make_context.py --check does not detect test files whose names do not match test_*.py (such as tests/mutant_helper.py or tests/conftest.py), because test_counts() uses a shallow TESTS.glob('test_*.py') and filters AST nodes strictly by def test_*. Across a 25-specimen battery, 0/20 non-test_*.py files, subdirectories, non-code assets, and helper edits were caught (0.0%), while 3/3 in-scope test modifications were 100% caught.
confidence: High. Measured on a 25-mutant battery in an isolated sandbox with baseline and undo controls, verified by AST code analysis of scripts/make_context.py, and supported by a census of all 87 items in tests/ and 79 historical git paths.
